segments.thag15.1:3.3: Evaṃ sammanti saṅkappā, yadā paññāya passati.
segments.thag15.1:4.1: [dha. pa.277 dhammapade]“Sabbe saṅkhārā aniccāti, yadā paññāya passati;
segments.thag15.1:4.3: Atha nibbindati dukkhe, esa maggo visuddhiyā.
segments.thag15.1:5.1: [dha. pa.278 dhammapade]“Sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhāti, yadā paññāya passati
segments.thag15.1:5.3: Atha nibbindati dukkhe, esa maggo visuddhiyā.
segments.thag15.1:6.1: [dha. pa.279 dhammapade]“Sabbe dhammā anattāti, yadā paññāya passati;
segments.thag15.1:6.3: Atha nibbindati dukkhe, esa maggo visuddhiyā.
segments.thag15.1:8.3: Chetvā khilañca pāsañca, selaṃ bhetvāna [chetvāna (ka.)] dubbhidaṃ;
segments.thag15.1:8.5: Tiṇṇo pāraṅgato jhāyī, mutto so mārabandhanā.
segments.thag15.1:16.3: So me attho anuppatto, kiṃ me saddhivihārinā”ti.
